title: A Randomized Controlled Trial Comparing STREAMLINE Canaloplasty to Trabecular Micro-Bypass Stent Implantation in Primary Open-Angle Glaucoma

license.statement: Dove Medical Press terms incorporating CC BY-NC 3.0 unported (article <license>); not CC BY, so the record is private

indication: mild-to-moderate primary open-angle glaucoma with visually significant cataract, on 1-3 topical medications at screening, post-washout IOP 22-34 mmHg
design: multicentre randomized controlled trial (VENICE, NCT05280366), one eye per subject, interim 6-month report of the first 72 randomized eyes

groups.description: STREAMLINE viscoelastic canaloplasty (3-8 applications, no trabecular incisions) after uncomplicated phacoemulsification
iStent inject W (two trabecular micro-bypass stents) after uncomplicated phacoemulsification

series.baseline_label: Baseline (Post Washout), morning average IOP at Eligibility (Table 7 VENICE row; identical to the Table 4 Baseline Post Washout cell)
series.notes: mean (SD); n per visit in Table 4: 35 at day 1, day 7 and month 1, 34 at month 3 (one missed visit), 33 at month 6 (one death, one missed visit); medicated pre-washout Screening IOP is tabulated in Table 4 row 3 but not used as the reference

series.baseline_label: Baseline (Post Washout), morning average IOP at Eligibility (Table 7 VENICE row; identical to the Table 4 Baseline Post Washout cell)
series.notes: mean (SD); n per visit in Table 4: 37 at every postoperative visit; medicated pre-washout Screening IOP is tabulated in Table 4 row 3 but not used as the reference

exclusions.what: Table 4 Screening (pre-washout, on medication) IOP, row 3
exclusions.reason: alternative reference of the same eyes; the study compares follow-up with the post-washout Baseline, which is used (brief: use the baseline the study itself compares with)

exclusions.what: Table 6 IOP of subjects off all IOP-lowering medications at month 6
exclusions.reason: analysis set selected by a postoperative outcome (medication-free at month 6)

exclusions.what: Table 7 rows of other MIGS studies and the VENICE Screening/Month 6/medication cells
exclusions.reason: other studies' values, or duplicates of Table 4 cells already cited; only the VENICE Baseline (Post Washout) cells are cited

exclusions.what: unmedicated diurnal Eligibility IOP stated in the Results text
exclusions.reason: text value, not a table cell; Table 4 uses the morning Eligibility IOP as Baseline

notes: Reference cell: the Table 4 'Baseline Post Washout' cells hold n and mean (SD) separated by a line break, which the cell reader joins into one number; the month-0 reference therefore cites the Table 7 VENICE 'Baseline (Post Washout)' cell of the same group (footnote: morning average IOP at Eligibility), whose mean and SD were checked identical to the Table 4 cell. Follow-up values cite Table 4.
Day 1 = 1/30.4375 months, day 7 = 7/30.4375 months, rounded to 4 decimals.
Goldmann applanation with a two-person masked reader; per-eye IOP was the average of two (or three) readings rounded to the nearest whole mmHg (Methods).

Medication: number of IOP-lowering medications per visit is tabulated in Table 5; not extracted. Medications were washed out before the Eligibility (Baseline) visit and restarted after surgery as needed.

Role ambiguity: the trial was designed to evaluate STREAMLINE canaloplasty against iStent inject W and is sponsored by the STREAMLINE manufacturer; both devices are FDA cleared/approved angle procedures and no arm is declared experimental or investigational, so both groups are role control (protocol: two standard techniques compared without an investigational agent).
Interim analysis of an ongoing trial with planned 24-month follow-up.
